# Product

Product teamspace for Stencil. Renee Alvarez runs product until we hire a CPO. Lin Zhao leads design. Kavi Raman owns growth and the experiments platform. PRDs, launch checklists, go/no-go notes, beta readouts, pricing and the card program all live here. Engineering designs live in Confluence (ENG and PLAT spaces) and are linked from the PRDs.

## Current focus: ETF investing (DriveWealth)

Beta to 5% of MTU since Sep 8. GA target Oct 20, at risk. Go/no-go #1 on Sep 29 was a NO-GO. Go/no-go #2 is Oct 16.

## Conventions

- Every PRD has goals, non-goals, requirements and success metrics. If it doesn't, it's a brief, not a PRD.
- Launch decisions are written down as "Decision:" lines with a name and a date.
- Open items use checkboxes with an owner and a date. If you can't put a date on it, it isn't an action item yet.
- Pillar Bank conditions (today: $2,500 daily funding cap per user for the first 90 days of investing) are product requirements, not suggestions.
